en.summary: OpenCove 0.3.0 keeps terminal and Agent work available across restarts, Desktop, browsers, and remote machines, while expanding what you can organize and use directly on the canvas.

items.summary: Organize larger projects with nested Child Spaces and reusable, provider-selectable roles.
Browse project files, edit documents with a full code editor, preview media, and open full website windows without leaving the canvas.
Set up and repair managed SSH remote machines, then browse and run work through their Remote Workers.
Install the standalone OpenCove CLI and Worker on macOS, Linux, or Windows servers without installing Desktop.
Choose Pi or Kimi Code for Agent work, and get Agent controls and status when launching supported commands from ordinary terminals.
Reload or switch resumable Agent sessions from the window header and receive a system notification when work finishes.
Navigate projects, Spaces, and Agents with the new grouped sidebar, pinned Space rail, Command Center, and Settings search.
Arrange, drag, resize, zoom, and use trackpad gestures more smoothly while keeping Space boundaries predictable.
Resume terminal and Agent work after restarts with output, input, and workspace context intact.
Keep terminals, history, and canvas position intact when using Desktop and the optional browser UI together.
Improve terminal clarity, sizing, focus, scrolling, and input behavior across Windows, macOS, Linux, and zoomed canvases.
Capture redacted issue reports and inspect performance snapshots when a session or canvas interaction misbehaves.

zh-CN.summary: OpenCove 0.3.0 让终端与 Agent 工作在重启、Desktop、浏览器和远程机器之间保持连续，同时大幅扩展了画布内可组织、可直接使用的内容。

items.summary: 使用可嵌套的子空间和可复用、可选择 Agent 的角色来组织更大型的项目。
无需离开画布即可浏览项目文件、使用完整代码编辑器编辑文档、预览媒体并打开网页窗口。
配置和修复通过 SSH 管理的远程机器，并通过 Remote Worker 浏览和运行远程工作。
无需安装 Desktop，即可在 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 服务器上安装独立的 OpenCove CLI 与 Worker。
可选择 Pi 或 Kimi Code 执行 Agent 工作，并在普通终端中启动受支持命令后获得 Agent 控制和状态。
从窗口标题栏重新加载或切换可恢复的 Agent 会话，并在任务完成时接收系统通知。
通过新的分组侧边栏、置顶空间栏、命令中心和设置搜索，更快地切换项目、空间和 Agent。
更流畅地整理、拖动、缩放窗口和画布，并让触控板操作与空间边界更稳定可预测。
应用重启后继续原有终端与 Agent 工作，并保留输出、输入能力和工作区上下文。
同时使用 Desktop 与可选浏览器界面时，保留终端、历史记录和画布位置。
改善 Windows、macOS、Linux 及缩放画布中的终端清晰度、尺寸、焦点、滚动和输入体验。
当会话或画布交互异常时，可生成脱敏问题报告并查看性能快照，便于定位问题。
